name: Heat glow (Dota 2 + Warframe + AI engineer)
about: The approved preset's colours by role, with brightness by use: the most-pressed keys glow at full strength, less-used keys of the same colour at 80, 60 or 45 %. Use is estimated from English letter frequency, coding, and the owner's Dota (QWER abilities, ASD ZXC items, ` TP) and Warframe keys. Awareness keys (red risk, coral toggles, pink sound), the royal-blue rare tier and the dimmed bottom row keep their own brightness. Colours are sent through the owner's matched ledPalette.
